# Iceberg DB — Complete Technical Reference (`llms-full.txt` • v1.0.0)


> **Brand & Disambiguation Note:** **IcebergDB** (`https://icebergdb.in`, `pip install icebergdb`, `npm install icebergdb`) is the flagship serverless AI vector database and 4-tier cognitive agent memory product built by **Iceberg** (Iceberg Database Technologies, founded by Ankush in India). It is an independent AI database platform and is **not affiliated with Apache Iceberg** (the big-data Parquet table format).
> Official Website: https://icebergdb.in
> Cloud Console: https://dashboard.icebergdb.in
> API Endpoint: https://api.icebergdb.in
> Documentation: https://icebergdb.in/docs
> Reproducible Benchmarks: https://icebergdb.in/benchmarks
> Security & RBAC: https://icebergdb.in/security
> Live Telemetry Status: https://icebergdb.in/status
> About & Founder: https://icebergdb.in/about

## 1. Overview & Architecture
Iceberg DB (`v1.0.0` Production Stable) is an India-hosted serverless vector database, hybrid RRF search engine (combining 384-dimensional dense Cosine similarity with Okapi BM25 lexical scoring), and 4-tier cognitive AI agent memory platform (`short_term`, `episodic`, `long_term`, `semantic`). Hosted in India (`ap-south-1`), it provides built-in server-side CPU embeddings (`ONNX all-MiniLM-L6-v2`, 384-dim) with zero external OpenAI API key requirement, and 100% India data residency to support DPDP Act 2023 data localization.

### Core Engine Stack
1. **API Gateway & Control Plane:** FastAPI over TLS 1.3 with SHA-256 API key hashing (`X-API-Key: ib_...`) and Role-Based Access Control (`admin`, `read_write`, `read_only`).
2. **Vector Storage Engine:** Qdrant HNSW (`384d` float32 Cosine similarity, `m=16`, `ef_construct=100`) with deterministic server-side tenant namespace isolation (`t_{uid8}__` and `u_{uid8}__`).
3. **Hybrid Lexical Scorer:** Okapi BM25 (`k1=1.5, b=0.75`) over full collection payloads fused with dense Cosine rankings via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (`RRF k=60`) and normalized score blending (`alpha=0.5` default).
4. **Built-in Server-Side CPU Embeddings:** Quantized ONNX `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` (`384d`) executing in `48.2 ms` min / `112.3 ms` p50 on CPU (`$0` external API cost).
5. **Zero Vendor Lock-In & Portability:** Full JSON/JSONL pagination via `GET /documents/{collection}/scroll`, single-point CRUD via `PUT/GET/DELETE /documents/{collection}/points/{point_id}`, point-in-time snapshots via `POST /backup/create/{collection}`, and Docker/Terraform BYOC self-hosting.

## 2. Canonical SDK Installation & Quickstart (`v1.0.0`)

> **Canonical Package Registry & Legacy Deprecation Notice (`v1.0.0`):** Only `icebergdb` (PyPI, npm, Crates.io), `IcebergDb` (NuGet), `github.com/anku5265/iceberg-database/iceberg-sdk-go` (Go), `io.icebergdb:iceberg-sdk:1.0.0` (Maven), and `iceberg-mcp` (MCP) are official `v1.0.0` packages. Legacy pre-release beta names (`iceberg-db`, `iceberg-js-sdk`, `iceberg-Vector-db`, `Iceberg.VectorDB`) are deprecated and retired.


### Python (`PyPI` — `v1.0.0`: `https://pypi.org/project/icebergdb/`)
```bash
pip install icebergdb
```
```python
from iceberg import Client

client = Client(api_key="ib_your_key")

# 1. Create collection & index raw text (server-side 384d CPU embeddings)
client.create_collection("my_docs")
client.index_text("my_docs", "Iceberg DB is hosted in India (ap-south-1) with hybrid RRF search.")

# 2. Hybrid Search (Dense 384d + BM25 via RRF)
results = client.search("my_docs", "where is Iceberg hosted?", search_type="hybrid", top_k=5)
for r in results:
    print(r.id, r.score, r.text)

# 3. 4-Tier Cognitive Agent Memory
client.remember("agent_001", "User prefers dark mode and Python", memory_type="long_term")
memories = client.recall("agent_001", "what does user prefer?", top_k=3)
```

### JavaScript / TypeScript (`npm` — `v1.0.0`: `https://www.npmjs.com/package/icebergdb`)
```bash
npm install icebergdb
```
```javascript
import { Client } from 'icebergdb'

const client = new Client({ apiKey: 'ib_your_key' })
await client.createCollection('my_docs')
await client.indexText('my_docs', 'Iceberg DB is hosted in India (ap-south-1).')
const results = await client.search('my_docs', 'where is Iceberg hosted?', { topK: 5 })
```

### Rust (`Crates.io` — `v1.0.0`: `https://crates.io/crates/icebergdb`)
```bash
cargo add icebergdb
```
```rust
use icebergdb::Client;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let client = Client::new("ib_your_key");
    let results = client.search("my_docs", "return policy", 5).await.unwrap();
}
```

### .NET / C# (`NuGet` — `v1.0.0`: `https://www.nuget.org/packages/IcebergDb`)
```bash
dotnet add package IcebergDb
```
```csharp
using IcebergDb;

var client = new IcebergClient("ib_your_key");
var results = await client.SearchAsync("my_docs", "return policy", topK: 5);
```

### Go (`pkg.go.dev` — `v1.0.0`)
```bash
go get github.com/anku5265/iceberg-database/iceberg-sdk-go
```

### Java (`Maven` — `v1.0.0`)
```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>io.icebergdb</groupId>
  <artifactId>iceberg-sdk</artifactId>
  <version>1.0.0</version>
</dependency>
```

### Model Context Protocol (`MCP` Server — `v1.0.0`: `https://www.npmjs.com/package/iceberg-mcp`)
```bash
claude mcp add icebergdb --env ICEBERG_API_KEY=ib_your_key -- npx -y iceberg-mcp
```

## 3. Rate Limits, Quotas & Error Handling (`https://icebergdb.in/docs`)
- **HTTP Status Codes:**
  - `200 OK`: Success.
  - `400 Bad Request`: Missing required field or invalid query.
  - `401 Unauthorized`: Missing, invalid, or revoked `X-API-Key`.
  - `403 Forbidden`: RBAC violation (e.g., `read_only` key attempting write/delete) or plan quota exceeded.
  - `404 Not Found`: Collection, point ID, or snapshot not found.
  - `422 Unprocessable Entity`: Invalid vector dimension (must be `384`) or non-finite floats (`NaN`/`Inf`).
  - `429 Too Many Requests`: Rate limit exceeded; retry with exponential backoff.
- **Plan Quotas & Burst Limits:**
  - **Free (`₹0`):** 100K vectors, 1K queries/day, 1 GB storage, 60 req/min burst, max 10 MB file upload, never pauses.
  - **Starter (`₹799/mo`):** 1M vectors, 20K queries/day, 5 GB storage, 300 req/min burst, max 25 MB upload, 5 projects.
  - **Growth (`₹3,499/mo`):** 5M vectors, 100K queries/day, 25 GB storage, 1,000 req/min burst, max 50 MB upload, 15 projects.
  - **Scale (`₹9,999/mo`):** 20M vectors, 500K queries/day, 100 GB storage, 3,000 req/min burst, max 100 MB upload, unlimited projects.

## 4. Reproducible Benchmark Summary (`https://icebergdb.in/benchmarks`)
- **Hardware & Environment:** 4 vCPU (x86_64 AVX2 SIMD), 16 GB DDR4 RAM, NVMe SSD, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, hosted in India (`ap-south-1`). Index config: `384-dim float32`, Cosine similarity, Qdrant HNSW (`m=16, ef_construct=100, ef_search=64`) + Okapi BM25 (`k1=1.5, b=0.75`) + RRF (`k=60, alpha=0.5`). Raw JSON telemetry: `https://icebergdb.in/benchmark-report.json`.
- **Evaluation Corpus:** 120-document technical & financial corpus (384-dim `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` vectors, 40 ground-truth queries mixing conceptual questions and exact alphanumeric IDs).
- **Stage-by-Stage Latency (`200 runs` after 20 warm-up iterations):**
  - **Dense Vector Lookup (`384d` Cosine):** `1.42 ms` min | `1.95 ms` `p50` | `3.80 ms` `p95` | `5.12 ms` `p99` (`95.0%` Recall@10).
  - **Sparse BM25 Keyword Scoring:** `4.85 ms` min | `6.93 ms` `p50` | `11.20 ms` `p95` | `14.65 ms` `p99` (`90.0%` Recall@10).
  - **Hybrid RRF (`Dense + BM25`, `alpha=0.5`):** `6.40 ms` min | `8.73 ms` `p50` | `13.39 ms` `p95` | `17.85 ms` `p99` (`97.5%` Recall@5, `100.0%` Recall@10, `0.677` MRR@10).
  - **Server-Side CPU Embedding (`ONNX`):** `48.25 ms` min | `112.34 ms` `p50` | `145.10 ms` `p95` | `218.40 ms` `p99`.
- **Dataset Size Scaling (`384-dim float32 Cosine, top_k=10, 200 runs`):**
  - `1,000 vectors`: `0.84 ms` min | `1.20 ms` p50 | `6.98 ms` p95 | `16.85 ms` p99 (`510 QPS`, `1.46 MB RAM`, `100.0% Recall@10`).
  - `10,000 vectors`: `1.95 ms` min | `2.53 ms` p50 | `6.11 ms` p95 | `8.88 ms` p99 (`324 QPS`, `14.65 MB RAM`, `100.0% Recall@10`).
  - `50,000 vectors`: `3.56 ms` min | `4.24 ms` p50 | `5.97 ms` p95 | `8.53 ms` p99 (`225 QPS`, `73.24 MB RAM`, `100.0% Recall@10`).
- **Concurrent User Load (`500 queries on 10,000 384d vectors`):**
  - `1 User`: `1.99 ms` p50 | `2.92 ms` p95 | `11.42 ms` p99 (`149 QPS`).
  - `10 Users`: `14.16 ms` p50 | `29.56 ms` p95 | `42.21 ms` p99 (`470 QPS`).
  - `50 Users`: `37.88 ms` p50 | `81.25 ms` p95 | `105.64 ms` p99 (`565 QPS`).
- **Architecture Transparency:** Iceberg DB uses Qdrant HNSW as its underlying cloud vector index alongside our `IcebergCore` SIMD/SQ8/BQ engine. Rather than comparing raw HNSW against Qdrant's Rust binary, Iceberg eliminates external US OpenAI embedding round-trips by executing server-side ONNX CPU embeddings + Qdrant HNSW + Okapi BM25 + RRF + 4-Tier Memory in one unified India (`ap-south-1`) pipeline.
